Unit tests for block dump protobuf round-trip serialization and field verification.

# Purpose
`test_dump_block.c` is a unit test file for the block dump logic in `fd_dump_pb.c`. It builds a full test fixture with a workspace, account database, bank state, stake delegation state, vote state caches, a scratch pad, a block dump context, and a capture context. The file loads two block context fixtures, one normal block and one epoch boundary block, then uses them to drive a round-trip test of block serialization to protobuf output.

The main test flow decodes an input block context, restores bank and epoch state, loads accounts into `funk`, registers vote accounts and stake delegations, collects transactions, and calls `fd_dump_block_to_protobuf`. It then reads the generated `block-<slot>.blockctx` file, decodes it again, and checks that the output matches the input for slot data, epoch data, features, inflation, blockhash queue, accounts, vote accounts, and transactions. The file also defines helper functions for feature restoration and for loading vote and stake state from `funk`, so it acts as a focused test harness for the block dump public interface.
